reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025, with its first and last day
  SELECT month_start, MIN(cal_date) AS first_day, MAX(cal_date) AS last_day
  FROM calendar
  WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY month_start
), open_stores AS (
  -- one row per month and store open on every day of it
  SELECT m.month_start, s.store_code
  FROM months m
  JOIN stores s ON s.opened_on <= m.first_day AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date >= m.last_day)
), revenue AS (
  -- one row per month and store with a sale
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', order_date) AS DATE), store_code
)
SELECT o.month_start, COUNT(*) AS stores_open, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.revenue, 0)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS revenue_per_store
FROM open_stores o
LEFT JOIN revenue r ON r.month_start = o.month_start AND r.store_code = o.store_code
GROUP BY o.month_start

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025, with its first and last day
  SELECT month_start, MIN(cal_date) AS first_day, MAX(cal_date) AS last_day
  FROM calendar
  WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT m.month_start,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores s WHERE s.opened_on <= m.first_day AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date >= m.last_day)) AS stores_open,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(x.net_revenue_eur) FROM sales x JOIN stores s ON s.store_code = x.store_code
    WHERE x.order_date BETWEEN m.first_day AND m.last_day
      AND s.opened_on <= m.first_day AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date >= m.last_day)), 0)
    / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores s WHERE s.opened_on <= m.first_day AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date >= m.last_day)), 2) AS revenue_per_store
FROM months m

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS month_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(m)
), open_st AS (
  SELECT m.month_start, st.store_code
  FROM months m JOIN stores st ON st.opened_on <= m.month_start
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= CAST(m.month_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE))
), rev AS (
  SELECT o.month_start, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev
  FROM open_st o JOIN sales s ON s.store_code = o.store_code
    AND s.order_date >= o.month_start AND s.order_date < CAST(o.month_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  GROUP BY o.month_start
), cnt AS (
  SELECT month_start, COUNT(*) AS n FROM open_st GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT m.month_start, c.n AS stores_open, ROUND(COALESCE(r.rev, 0) / c.n, 2) AS revenue_per_store
FROM months m JOIN cnt c ON c.month_start = m.month_start LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.month_start = m.month_start
